note: The "before" point: today's researcher has one mode and answers every question at about 120 words. It does not report the time to its first word or whether it chose a short or a long answer, so those checks are empty here. "After" is the same 121 questions on the new researcher, which answers short by default and long when the question needs it.
scored_by: code checks only (no model judges the answers); see backend/evals/research_depth/README.md
bar_measured_on: the questions kept aside from tuning (43% of them), each asked three times
